title: [応用] Partial Indexで有効データだけを索引化する
statement: 論理削除されたメッセージは通常一覧に出しません。SELECT * FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = 42 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50; を対象に、未削除行だけを保持するpartial indexを作ってください。インデックス名は自由です。
starterSql: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT);
solutionSql: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT); CREATE INDEX idx_active_messages ON messages(tenant_id, created_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
checkSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master sm JOIN pragma_index_list('messages') il ON il.name=sm.name WHERE sm.type='index' AND lower(replace(sm.sql,' ','')) LIKE '%wheredeleted_atisnull%' AND (SELECT group_concat(name, ',') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) ORDER BY seqno)='tenant_id,created_at') AS ok;

benchmark.query: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = 42 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.expression: CASE WHEN row_number % 5=0 THEN '2026-02-01' ELSE NULL END
